oe_amr_act_elysian_foederati_exchange = {
	type = owncountry
	sound = UI_action_government_generic
	show_message = no

	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			oe_amr_is_haudenosaunee_axis = yes
			has_global_variable = oe_amr_elysia_pact
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = oe_amr_elysia_pact }
				global_var:oe_amr_elysia_pact = 1
			}
		}
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			oe_amr_elysia_present = yes
			gold >= 80
			at_war = no
			NOT = { has_cooldown = oe_amr_act_elysian_exchange_cd }
		}
	}

	cooldown = {
		type = oe_amr_act_elysian_exchange_cd
		years = 10
	}

	automation_tick = never
	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 24
	ai_prerequisite = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		at_war = no
		gold >= 120
	}

	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			add_gold = -80
			add_country_modifier = {
				modifier = oe_amr_foederati_iron_firearms_mod
				years = 10
				mode = replace
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_amr_elysia_exchange_count } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_amr_elysia_exchange_count value = 0 }
			}
			change_variable = { name = oe_amr_elysia_exchange_count add = 1 }
		}
		random_country = {
			limit = {
				oe_eln_is_elysia = yes
				num_locations > 0
			}
			add_gold = 60
			add_country_modifier = {
				modifier = oe_amr_elysia_longhouse_fur_compact_mod
				years = 10
				mode = replace
			}
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = 25
	}
}
